content: उररी {%ind.%} [ऊर्यादिच्विडाचश्च <ls>P. I. 4. 61</ls>] A particle implying (1) assent, admission or acceptance. (In this sense it is usually used with the roots कृ, भू, or अस् and it has the force of a गति or preposition; उररीकृत्य not उररीकृत्वा. Other forms of the word are उरी, उरुरी, ऊरी and ऊरुरी.); (2) Extension.
